description: This file handles creation, editing, updating, and deletion of custom fields within a testing management web application. It manages user actions via form submissions, interacts with a custom field manager, and renders corresponding templates via Smarty. It also defines functions for processing form requests, managing configuration settings, and controlling UI display logic for custom fields.

methods.name: getCFCfg
methods.description: Constructs and returns the configuration object containing custom field settings, options, and application areas.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes and returns the view GUI object for custom field management.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for editing a specific custom field based on provided arguments.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Processes creation of a new custom field from form data, handling checks for duplicate names and logging.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field with new data submitted through a form, verifying name uniqueness.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specified custom field and logs the operation.

methods.name: cfieldCfgInit
methods.description: Initializes and returns a configuration object for custom field settings, including application areas and display options.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Determines whether to render the GUI templates based on user actions, setting Smarty variables and displaying the appropriate template.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Validates whether the current user has rights to manage custom fields.
